stage: S1W — Existing-Corpus Weakly Supervised CLAPSep Domain Adaptation
decision_basis: Primary human blind listening (18 items, unblinded 2026-09-14; see listening_pack/HUMAN_LISTENING_RESULTS.md) confirming the frozen machine-side real test (REAL_TEST_RESULTS.md, FAILURE_CASES.md §1-2).
constructed_dev_evidence: On constructed weak-supervision mixtures the adapted decoder improved nuisance leakage -0.8 -> -10.3 dB (~9.4 dB) while improving target reconstruction 3.3x, weak-hit preservation 3.3x, friction preservation 4x, and flipped the zero-shot HF-muffling signature positive (DEV_RESULTS.md). Checkpoint-reload verified.
real_domain_evidence: On all six frozen real sealed groups the adapted output is near-silent (RMS -47.7..-51.5 dBFS vs raw -16.9..-20.4; 27.4-32.7 dB below RAW, c8 14.3 dB). The owner perceived all six adapted listening items (1/5/7/11/15/17) as near-silent / severely suppressed.
catastrophic_target_deletion_evidence: Adapted click/mid bands 17.7-33.4 dB down on every real group (REAL_TEST_RESULTS.md); human listening confirms authentic interaction deleted together with the nuisance.
zeroshot_selectivity_evidence: Owner attested useful source selectivity retained, especially c3 (Taiko system prompt); machine side: transients within ~1-2 dB of raw, music ~4-9 dB relative attenuation (S1E-consistent).
zeroshot_residual_defects: muffling / underwater texture / discontinuity (owner stage-summary attestation; consistent with S1E listening record)
primary_root_cause_detail: The decoder learned the constructed-mixture distribution (canvas-reconstructed proxies vs pristine/ambience nuisance) rather than the product target (FAILURE_CASES.md §1: proxy music bleed, absent speech class, friction proxies the most real-like and the only class partially surviving). Independently, the adapted masker is sensitive to the inference chunk protocol (zero-padded vs exact 10-s chunks flip behavior; FAILURE_CASES.md §2) - a context/robustness failure of the adapted model, not of zero-shot.
bounded_mask_limitation: NOT established as the cause of adaptation collapse
bounded_mask_limitation_detail: The bounded real-valued mask representation was left unchanged by design (S1a oracle ceiling still applies to any future masker redesign). The observed collapse is explained by training-distribution mismatch and chunk sensitivity; nothing in S1W implicates the mask representation.

listening_evidence.pack: listening_pack/ v2 gain-corrected (18 items, no per-item normalization)
listening_evidence.protocol_correction: v1 pack invalid (per-item -3 dBFS peak norm); regenerated as v2 before listening; see listening_pack/LISTENING_PACK_GAIN_AUDIT.md

why_C_and_not_B: CLAPSep zero-shot remains a useful substrate, but the stage's own adaptation attempt catastrophically deletes the target on real material; S1W's question ('does weak supervision move CLAPSep toward the physical interaction without deleting it?') is answered NO on real handcams. Continuing the stage would require exactly what is ruled out: more tuning of the same synthetic-proxy recipe.
stage_should_not_continue_with: further tuning of the same synthetic-proxy/remixing recipe

next_stage_recommendation.focus: REAL-MIXTURE adaptation - learning from authentic handcam acoustic distributions rather than better synthetic remixing
candidate_approaches: anti-collapse / identity constraints (e.g. penalize wholesale output suppression)
learning directly from authentic handcam acoustic distributions
